named_hazards_a_replay_cannot_see: generate_and_store_keys fills daily_key and recovery_key ONLY when they are None. A second call returns the existing keys. A port written as an unconditional generate-then-store overwrites the owner's recovery key and orphans every existing snapshot, and returns success.
mutate_journal_config returns before taking the lock and before writing when the computed change is a no-op. A port that always reports changed writes on every call.
coverage_limits.note: A green replay proves the recorded GET bodies and the recorded rejection bodies. It proves nothing about any route below, and those routes must be checked by reading the reference.
